name: SBGCT [TESTING]
desc:
Game is being updated and more content is planned, stay tuned!
Join the community server for more info and planned updates.

This game is compatible with Console and Mobile!  🎮 📱
Fight or train others to become the strongest. 🏆

Controls:
Q / Button Y - Directional Dash (When in ragdoll state, use for an evasive)
Q / Button Y (While moving forward) - Wall Combo
Left Click / Button B - Light Attack
F / Button X - Block

Mobile:
Arrange and use the buttons provided in-game. You can resize and move them in the settings.
